info.title: SaySerné API
info.description:
The public API used by the web site (and the mobile app). Generated from the code.

**Signing in.** `POST /api/auth/login` (or register / Google) sets the `sayserne.auth` cookie; send it with every request. **Cross-site protection.** Every request that changes data (anything but GET) must carry an `Origin` header the API allows, or the header `X-Requested-With: sayserne-web`; otherwise it is refused with `CSRF_REJECTED`. A native app has no `Origin`, so it sends the header.

**Errors** use one shape (see `Error`). **Responses** are JSON unless noted; their exact shapes are the types in `web/src/api.ts`. Times are UTC ISO 8601. Business limits (lengths, counts, durations) are runtime settings published by `GET /api/config/public`; texts and lists come from `/api/translations/{language}` and `/api/lookups/{type}`.
